policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: The composer's Auto adjust toggle was removed after 0.27.0: every Agent run now freezes team limits on its own. A turn queued before then carries agentRunAdaptive, and the queued-turn schema is strict, so workspace snapshot parsing drops the key before parsing. At expiry, delete the marked block and parse queued turns with the plan-mode-free schema; a turn still queued from 0.27.0 then fails the strict schema.

Through 0.27.3 pre-PR review ran only when prePrReviewEnabled and its Background AI lane's enabled were both on, and inline completion only when editorAiCompletions and its lane's enabled were both on. After 0.27.3 pre-PR review uses only its lane enabled and inline completion only editorAiCompletions. Settings rehydration writes the old AND into the switch that stays (a pre-PR review lane saved without enabled counts as on, the old lane default; for a profile that still has prePrReviewEnabled, an inline-completion lane missing or saved without enabled counts as off, the old lane default), drops prePrReviewEnabled and the inline-completion lane's enabled, and runs only while one of them is still saved. At expiry, delete the marked blocks and the wrapper call in app.store.ts; a profile that skipped these releases keeps its pre-PR review lane value (on unless it was turned off there) and its editorAiCompletions value, so a lane that was off through only its other switch turns on.

Through 0.27.3 Jira polled only when jiraConnector.enabled (default off) and trackerIssues.sourceEnabled.jira (default on) were both on. After 0.27.3 Jira uses only jiraConnector.enabled, the Settings → Integrations switch. Settings rehydration writes the old AND into jiraConnector.enabled (a saved sourceEnabled.jira that is not a boolean counts as on, the old default; a profile saved without jiraConnector stays off), drops sourceEnabled.jira, and runs only while sourceEnabled.jira is still saved. At expiry, delete the marked blocks; a profile that skipped these releases keeps its jiraConnector.enabled value, so Jira that was off only through the Issues source flag turns on.
